crossRefs.note: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said…
The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do…
Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be…
But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

translations.web: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
translations.bsb: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
